scope: CPU-deformed actual geometry and deterministic simulation, not WebGL/device performance

support.note: Actual skinned central-palm triangles, excluding fingertips/thumb tip/cuff. Heights are relative to nominal y=0. Proximity/orientation diagnostic only, not force or balance simulation.

kinematics.method: Both kernels evaluated against the same final anatomy and physical captures. World and hip-relative speeds are interval distances / dt; angular change is upper-arm direction, per frame. Instantaneous estimates use symmetric 10us finite differences at the peak interval midpoint.

numericCleanupEquality.method: Strict deep equality of complete keeperGather outputs at every sample, using identical source/current poses and physical capture point.
